intro: Assigned by Kadrak at the border watchtower between the northern Barrens and Ashenvale, this mission tasks couriers with coordinating field intel across the contested forest. Adventurers must deliver standing orders and collect front-line reconnaissance from outriders stationed near Azshara, Splintertree Post, and the Zoram Strand.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I recently deployed a few scouts into Ashenvale and I need a runner to take them their orders, and bring me back a report of what they have observed.

Your first stop should be the Zoram'gar Outpost, along the coast to the west, at the Zoram Strand, to locate the first runner. You also need to stop at Splintertree Post, to the north, and along the road to the east, near Azshara. You will find a scout and an outrider there.
Give them each a report, and from them, get an update on their findings.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hurry, friend. They must receive their reports; it is urgent.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can see that you are one that can be counted on. These updates are crucial to our plans to further our presence in Ashenvale. We can now plan our next move.
